items.title: Staggered age of consent to be discussed after Brand case, minister says
items.summary: A woman who alleges she was raped by the jailed comedian when she was 16 is campaigning to see relationships between 16-and 17-year-olds and adults made illegal.

items.title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
items.summary: The Ukrainian president says the slowed-down internet is making it difficult to stop Russian attacks.

items.title: Prince Harry praises war veterans on surprise visit to Ukraine
items.summary: He has been showing support for injured veterans in Ukraine and praising the country's resilience.

items.title: UK will have 'voice' but no vote on EU food rules in Brexit reset
items.summary: EU minister Hamish Falconer insists Britain would have some influence on policy as part of a new deal.

items.title: Cut national insurance for under-25s to create jobs, Milburn report to say
items.summary: The report being launched this week will suggest gradually reducing employment costs over five years.

items.title: Trident submarine returns home after record-breaking undersea patrol
items.summary: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting was at HM Naval Base Clyde to welcome the crew after the longest deployment at sea for a British vessel.

items.title: Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds
items.summary: Four people have been arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving, police say.

items.title: Brand moved from Wandsworth to category C prison, his wife confirms on podcast
items.summary: The convicted rapist has been moved to HMP Littlehey, which houses sex offenders.
